name: Armoured Infantry
legend: The rattle of tracks and the hammering of gunfire heralds the advance of armoured infantry. These forces are ideally suited to aggressively seizing strategic objectives, reinforcing buckling Imperial lines, responding to enemy attacks or capitalising on strategic gains. The combination of well-trained and equipped infantry with armoured transports is tried and tested. Transport vehicles lend their passengers speed and operational range far in excess of infantry operating on foot, provide protection on the way into battle, and offer fire support once the infantry have disembarked. In return, the troops can dig in, hold ground, and protect their transports from the enemy. Most often, the Astra Militarum deploys its armoured infantry elements at company strength. They either work hand in mailed gauntlet with tank formations or as massed assault elements which – when properly supported – can grind even the most elite foes into the dirt and secure the field for the armies of Mankind.

rules.name: Squadron Command
rules.legend: Officers in charge of motorised formations are as well versed in armoured combat as in infantry operations.
rules.description_html:
Add Squadron to the list of units each Officer unit from your army can issue Orders to. Add the Order below to those listed in the Voice of Command ability.

ON MY SIGNAL

The most effective commanders know how and when to make use of their armoured fighting vehicles’ speed.

This Order can only be issued to Armoured Skirmisher units (see below). Each time an enemy unit ends a Normal or Advance move within 9" of this unit, this unit can make a Normal move of up to D6". Each unit can only move in this way once per turn.

KEYWORDS
Astra Militarum Squadron units from your army have the ARMOURED SKIRMISHER keyword (excluding Artillery units and units containing one or more models with a Wounds characteristic of 13 or higher).

stratagems.name: OPENING SALVO
stratagems.legend: Emerging from their armoured transports, heavily armed soldiers open fire before enemies can dive for cover or angle their stoutest armour towards the fusillade.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One ASTRA MILITARUM unit from your army that disembarked from a Transport this turn and has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Wound roll.

stratagems.name: ORDER THE ADVANCE
stratagems.legend: At a barked order, armour and infantry surge forward as one, utilising speed and aggression to close with objectives and the enemy.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Start of your Movement phase.

TARGET: One Astra Militarum Officer unit from your army.

EFFECT: Select one or more friendly ASTRA MILITARUM units within 6" of your unit; until the end of the phase, you can re-roll Advance rolls made for those units.
stratagems.description_text:

TARGET: One Astra Militarum Officer unit from your army.

EFFECT: Select one or more friendly ASTRA MILITARUM units within 6" of your unit; until the end of the phase, you can re-roll Advance rolls made for those units.

stratagems.name: SUPPORTING ORDNANCE
stratagems.legend: This vehicle’s heavy weapons support lightly equipped infantry, suppressing enemy armour and bringing down lumbering monsters.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One Armoured Skirmisher unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack that targets a visible MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: COMBINED FIRE
stratagems.legend: Hammering the enemy, this transport’s crew share targeting solutions with nearby allies, allowing for concentrated combined fire to obliterate the foe’s infantry and even erode armour plating.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, just after an Armoured Skirmisher unit from your army has shot.

TARGET: That ARMOURED SKIRMISHER unit.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the end of the phase, that enemy unit cannot have the Benefit of Cover, and each time an ARMOURED SKIRMISHER unit from your army makes an attack that targets that unit, improve the Strength characteristic of that attack by 2.

stratagems.name: MOBILE FIREBASE
stratagems.legend: Armoured fighting vehicles and transports keep pace with the infantry, supporting the advance as mobile gun platforms
stratagems.description_html:

TARGET: That ARMOURED SKIRMISHER unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back.

stratagems.legend: Pushing bodies or engines to the limit, these warriors continue their swift advance.
stratagems.description_html:

enhancements.name: Exemplary Officer
enhancements.legend: Possessed of great initiative and authority, this officer marshals surrounding assets with great efficiency.
enhancements.description_html: Infantry Officer model only. Each time the bearer issues an Order to its own unit, you can select up to two other Platoon units within 3" of the bearer’s unit. That Order is also issued to each of those units.

enhancements.name: Master Manoeuvrist
enhancements.legend: Academy training and battlefield experience have instilled in this officer a mastery of mobile warfare. At their barked orders, soldiers and armoured vehicles work in well-drilled unison.
enhancements.description_html: Infantry Officer model only. At the end of your opponent’s Fight phase, if the bearer’s unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and every model in that unit is within 3" of an Astra Militarum Transport from your army, it can embark within that TRANSPORT.

enhancements.name: Omnissian Unguents  (Aura)
enhancements.legend: Tech-Priests of the Adeptus Mechanicus bear to battle an array of sanctified oils and tinctures of protection with which to bless the Machine God’s divine works.
enhancements.description_html: Astra Militarum Tech-Priest Enginseer model only. While a friendly Armoured Skirmisher unit is within 3" of the bearer, that unit has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

enhancements.name: Grand Strategist
enhancements.legend: Able to see the broader strategic picture, this experienced officer deploys their assets sparingly and with practised precision.
enhancements.description_html: Officer model only. After both players have deployed their armies, if the bearer’s unit (or any Transport it is embarked within) is on the battlefield, select up to two units with the Regiment or Squadron keywords from your army and redeploy them. When doing so, you can set those units up in Strategic Reserves, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.
